issues.summary: Memory correction loop asks for the wrong follow-up action
issues.description: When a pending memory correction exists, a new correction prompt must replace the old pending workflow.

comments.author: QA
comments.body: Reproduce by creating an ambiguous delete pending, then sending a new update request.

comments.author: Developer
comments.body: Guardrail should clear old pending state before evaluating a new explicit correction request.
